snippet.title: Waterpark Simulator - Official Early Access Trailer
snippet.description:
Waterpark Simulator Early Access is coming AUGUST 22ND, 2025!

💦Wishlist now and get ready: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3293260/Waterpark_Simulator/
🏖️Play the free demo here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3730180/Waterpark_Simulator_Demo/

Build your dream waterpark, ride your own slides, explore other players' parks, and cause chaos with your friends. This is a physics-based sandbox sim that does not take itself too seriously and it's only just getting started.

🎮 ABOUT THE DEVELOPER

CayPlay Studios is an indie game studio co-founded by @Caylus and Travis Richardson. Focused on open-ended, creator-friendly games full of fun and chaos, Waterpark Simulator is Cayplay’s debut title with more to come.

Press Contact: press@cayplay.com
Presskit: https://impress.games/press-kit/cayplay-studios/waterpark-simulator

For more info and updates:
💬Discord: https://discord.com/invite/waterparksimulator
🐦X/Twitter: https://x.com/WaterParkSim
🎵  Tiktok: https://www.tiktok.com/@waterparksimulatorgame

Video Produced & Edited by: Patrick Snipes 
X/Twitter: https://x.com/FTT_Pat

#WaterparkSimulator #GameplayTrailer #EarlyAccess #SimulationGames #CayPlay #IndieGame
